# Alegreya

- Family: Alegreya, variable font (`wght` axis 400-900), file `Alegreya[wght].ttf`, version 2.009.
- Upstream: https://github.com/huertatipografica/Alegreya (the project publishes sources only).
- Binary: google/fonts commit c30b221beb0c1da59d563feb91ec8656a1fa972a, `ofl/alegreya/Alegreya[wght].ttf`
  (https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/c30b221beb0c1da59d563feb91ec8656a1fa972a/ofl/alegreya).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, text in `OFL.txt`.
- Use: UI v2 text stack (`ui2-text`) tests and skin fonts. See `third_party/NOTICE-ui-fonts.md`.
